newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Tuapse oil pipeline repairs nearly complete - Tass.
newsitem.headline: Tuapse oil pipeline repairs nearly complete - Tass.

text.p: Repairs to an oil pipeline feeding the Black Sea export terminal of Tuapse were nearly completed, the Emergency Situations Ministry said on Thursday.

A section of the line running from Tikhoretsk to Tuapse was closed due to a small hole in the link. The ministry, quoted by Prime-Tass news agency, said that an accident caused the hole to appear at 08.25 Moscow time (0525 GMT) and that corrosion was probably to blame.
Only a tiny amount of oil spilled, and the ministry said the leaked crude covered 104 square metres.
The hole was in a section of pipeline near the town of Ust-Labinsk, west of Krasnodar.
The ministry did not quantify the impact on total oil exports from Tuapse. Fuel oil, gas oil and crude are lifted from the port.
